ACBA - Polyglot Developer (5-10)
India-Remote
Full-Time - 5-10 Years
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain backend systems using a variety of programming languages.
Contribute to projects involving Generative AI or AI technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to team best practices.
Troubleshoot and debug complex issues across different technology stacks.

Requirements

5 to 10 years of professional experience in software development.
Demonstrated experience with multiple backend programming languages.
Experience with Generative AI or AI technologies.
Ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Mandatory Skills
Proven experience with at least two backend programming languages from the following:
Polyglot (React, FullStack exp, Python, FastAPI and MongoDB and AWS and AI (RAG, LLMs)
Generative AI/AI Experience
Desirable Skills
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Microservices architecture
Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Database management (SQL, NoSQL)
API design and development
Agile methodologies
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Masters degree in a relevant technical discipline.
Experience contributing to open-source projects.
Certifications in AI/ML or specific programming languages.
